brief_summary: The objective of the study is to test the effectiveness of a community pharmacist-led intervention to increase adherence to lipid lowering treatment.
brief_title: A Community Pharmacist-led Intervention to Improve Adherence to Lipid-lowering Treatment
collaborators: Department of Clinical Pharmacy, University Medical Centre St Radboud, The Netherlands.
Scientific Institute for Dutch Pharmacists, The Netherlands
Federation of Patients and Consumer Organisations in the Netherlands

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Suboptimal adherent to statin treatment
* Older than 65 years
* Responsible for own medication intake

Exclusion Criteria:

* Life expectancy shorter than 6 months
* Institutionalized
* User of medication blisters

official_title: A Community Pharmacist-led Intervention to Improve Adherence to Lipid-lowering Treatment

primary_outcomes.measure: The primary outcome will be mean differences in adherence over 365 days after randomization by comparing the two intervention groups with the control group.
